verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a local-evaluation mode in which Flagsmith server SDKs evaluate flags in-process from a cached ruleset. The Edge Proxy is a separate self-hosted service that server SDKs connect to over the network, so it is an adjacent feature rather than in-SDK local evaluation. Community discussion describes Flagsmith as 'primarily server-side eval', and the CLI's SDK-style evaluation is not the server-SDK capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check
